record.question: For claiming medical reimbursement, what documents are usually needed?
record.explanation: Answer C: Both (a) and (b). Reimbursement claims commonly require supporting bills/receipts and a medical certificate or other clinical documentation, but requirements vary by insurer and scheme. Source/context note: “Usually” is payer-specific; confirm the relevant scheme/insurer requirements. Reference: https://www.nha.gov.in/PM-JAY. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
